CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles
    where id = auth.uid()
      and active = true
      and role in ('owner','admin','reception','trainer')
  );
$function$
